verdict.rationale: Dynadot's docs confirm it offers DNS management: the API manages DNS, the MCP server can review DNS records, the WHMCS integration lets users adjust DNS settings, and llms.txt lists DNS among its services. Nothing in the evidence describes the hosted DNS itself in any detail. missing for 10: list of supported record types, TTL limits or low-TTL support, any description or hands-on review of the DNS management UI, independent corroboration that DNS hosting comes free with the domain.
